versions.changelog:
Initial release of browser4-cli: browser automation CLI for Chrome/Chromium with accessibility-tree snapshots.

- Automates browser tasks like navigation, form filling, clicking, screenshots, and data extraction via CLI.
- Uses accessibility-tree snapshots with element "refs" for robust page interaction.
- Headless mode is enforced by default; visible ("headed") mode only on explicit user request.
- Introduces ephemeral element refs—always re-snapshot after interactions to get fresh refs.
- Supports tab, session, and configuration management with clear command families and templates.
